We can't afford to have them get near the research outpost.|audio = Outpost32OperationICEWave-4.ogg|[[Dispatcher]] on Wave 4 ([[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)|Outpost 32]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Siege Engine''', internally referred to as '''Frost Spawner''', was an enemy that only appears in [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)|Outpost 32]] as part of the [[Operation I.C.E Event]]. Unlike other enemies in the event and even the game in general, it does not head to the exit and instead acts as the entrance for enemies to spawn from. It is still an enemy despite this, having its own statistics, an [[Index]] entry and even being affected by modifiers which apply hats to enemies like the [[Fireworks]] modifier. It will kill units that collide with it and trigger road obstacles. As it drives on the path, it will run over all enemies in its path, killing them. It uses its own path instead of the regular one, though the main difference here is that its path takes a few shortcuts. This enemy is not required to be destroyed for waves to progress. While it has multiple attributes, they are all applied so that it is immune to as many sources of damage as possible and to prevent towers from attacking it. Its [[No Target]] and [[Full Immunity|God]] attributes can be removed with the [[Pumpkin Bomb]], which will also boost its health from 0 to 50,000 (100,000 if the [[Pumpkin Bomb]] also applied [[Bloated]]), making it possible to be destroyed. ==Logbook Description== "''The Frost Spawner used in Outpost 32 to take down the Outpost's defenses. How did you get this anyways?!?''" ==Appearance== The '''Siege Engine''' is a light blue siege engine, mostly empty except for a blue portal. When it moves on the path, the portal will be closed via an overhead hatch, and a trail of wind will appear near it. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)|Outpost 32]] is listed instead. *You do not need to, and cannot, destroy the '''Siege Engine''' in most regular occurrences. *If you need to destroy the '''Siege Engine''' for the [[Logbooks|Logbook]] do note that it is extremely cumbersome and time-consuming. **You require the use of the [[Pumpkin Bomb]] removing the [[No Target]] and the [[Full Immunity|God]] attributes. Therefore, it can only be destroyed on [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)|Outpost 32]] Easy difficulty, as the Hard difficulty does not permit the use of consumables. ***The odds of this occurring is extremely low, so you will likely require multiple [[Pumpkin Bomb]] for these attributes to be removed. **Once [[Full Immunity|God]] and [[No Target]] attributes are removed, you can set any towers to target last which will enable you to destroy the '''Siege Engine''', with the exception of the [[Accelerator]], which is unable to target the '''Siege Engine''', even with [[No Target]] removed. ***Towers with long range, such as the [[Ranger]], and the [[Pursuit]] are suited for this. ***You can also use the [[Nuke]] to destroy the '''Siege Engine''', though the [[Full Immunity|God]] attribute must be removed first. ***After it is destroyed, enemies will still spawn normally at where the '''Siege Engine''' was at before. **The [[Gatling Gun]] can bypass the [[No Target]] attribute with its ''FPS'' ability, however you still need to get rid of the [[Full Immunity|God]] attribute. ==Sounds== {{Sounds|{{pe| {| class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750px; margin:0 auto;" |- ! style{{=}}"width:30%;" |Sound ! style{{=}}"width:70%;" |Description |- |[[File:FrostSpawnerDrive.ogg]] |Diving sound |- |[[File:FrostSpawnerOpen.ogg]] |Opening sound |- |[[File:FrostSpawnerClose.ogg]] |Closing sound |- |} }}}} ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseFrostSpawner.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 - Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} SiegeEngineFireworks.png|'''Siege Engine''' wearing a hat from the [[Fireworks]] modifier. SpawnerRuin.png|'''Siege Engine''' on the [[Wretched Front]] map. FrostSpawner.png|'''Siege Engine''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *This is the second enemy with the [[Full Immunity|God]] attribute. *If the player spawns a '''Siege Engine''' in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, it will head towards the exit without stopping. ==Update History== *'''16 December 2024''' - [[v1.46.0]] **'''Siege Engine''' added. **{{Bug}} '''Siege Engines''' can sometimes be positioned at the wrong angle. **{{Bug}} '''Siege Engine''' can sometimes stay closed after it stops moving, though this is purely visual. **{{Bug}} '''Siege Engine''' cannot be highlighted. *'''8 January 2025''' - [[v1.48.0]] **Now has a description in the [[Index]]. *'''15 January 2025''' - [[v1.49.0]] **'''Siege Engine''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''19 June 2026''' - [[v2.1.0]] **{{Bugfix}} '''Siege Engine''' can now be highlighted. ==Notes== {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Operation I.C.E]]
